'''''Koh-Lanta: Pacifique''''' is the fifth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from July 5, 2005 to August 31, 2005.

[[Clémence Castel]] defeated [[Francis Pierre-Jacque]] in a 7-0 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]]. To date, this season has produced four returning players (Clémence Castel, [[Coumba Baradji]], Francis Pierre-Jacque and [[Mohamed Derradji]]) for future seasons.

== Production ==
This season was filmed on the Isle of Pines in New Caledonia.

==Twists==
* '''[[Older vs. Younger|Old vs. Young]]:''' The castaways were divided into two [[Tribe|tribes]] based on their ages. {{tribeicon|kanawa}} consisted of castaways over the age of 30, and {{tribeicon|kumo}} consisted of castaways aged 30 and younger.
* '''Double Elimination:''' On Day 3, Kumo had openly discussed their votes at [[Tribal Council]], which is against the rules of ''Koh-Lanta'', so they were forced to vote out a second member of their tribe.
* '''Replacements:''' Due to the Double Elimination, [[Caroline Colusso]] entered the game on Day 5 to replace [[Aude Réant]] and/or [[Mathieu Huguin]]. After [[Sylvie Sébert]]'s evacuation, [[Francis Bordas]] returned to the game to replace her.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' After winning the [[Reward Challenge]] on Day 11, Kanawa could permanently take one of Kumo's members. They chose [[Jérôme Villaseque]], who would be immune at Kanawa's next Tribal Council.
